{"consolidated_memory":"INFINITE RECURSION IN graph/traversal/walker.rs — Four Separate Incidents (2026-02-13 through 2026-06-29)

The walker module has experienced infinite recursion four times, each with a different root cause and triggering condition. All four manifested as stack overflow until the guard tripped.

INCIDENT 1: [2026-02-13] Environment File Misconfiguration
- Trigger: General (appeared after client retry)
- Root cause: Config loader reading wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity (PR #3230, branch fix/infinite-recursion-1)
- Reproduction: Walk cyclic fixture graph
- Test coverage: Module test block in graph/traversal/walker.rs
- Outcome: Backlog cleared 84 minutes after deploy

INCIDENT 2: [2026-03-07] Naive vs. Aware Datetime Comparison
- Trigger: Sessions arriving through OAuth provider
- Root cause: Naive datetime compared against timezone-aware datetime
- Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #5294, branch fix/infinite-recursion-2)
- Reproduction: Walk cyclic fixture graph
- Test coverage: Module test block in graph/traversal/walker.rs
- Outcome: Memory settled at 413 MB instead of climbing past 2 GB

INCIDENT 3: [2026-03-26] Missing Transaction Wrapper
- Trigger: Users in negative UTC offset
- Root cause: Two writes never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #7123, branch fix/infinite-recursion-3)
- Reproduction: Walk cyclic fixture graph
- Test coverage: Module test block in graph/traversal/walker.rs
- Outcome: Job finished in 80 minutes instead of 6 hours

INCIDENT 4: [2026-06-29] Schema Drift Between Migration and Model
- Trigger: Traffic arriving through corporate proxy
- Root cause: Schema drift between the migration and the model definition
- Fix: Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum (PR #9746, branch fix/infinite-recursion-4)
- Reproduction: Walk cyclic fixture graph
- Test coverage: Module test block in graph/traversal/walker.rs
- Outcome: Alert stayed quiet for 31 consecutive days

Common Pattern: All four incidents appeared in graph/traversal/walker.rs on the graph engine side, signaled by stacks growing until the guard tripped, reproduced via cyclic fixture graph walking, and covered by the module test block in the same file."}
